description: Effect Best Practices Remediation - Fix catchAll, generic Error, and error handling patterns

effect.notes: Functional TypeScript framework. Use Schema.TaggedError for domain errors, catchTag for discriminated handling.

bun.notes: Runtime and test runner. Tests use @codeforbreakfast/bun-test-effect for Effect integration.

cloudflare.notes: Durable Objects for session state. session-do.ts is outside Effect runtime by design.

testing_policy.mandatory: EVERY story MUST include tests. A story is NOT complete without passing tests.
testing_policy.no_exceptions: Do NOT mark a story as complete if tests are missing or failing.

stories.title: Replace generic Error with DOStateError
stories.description: Create DOStateError tagged error and refactor session-state-store.ts to use it instead of generic Error class in Effect.tryPromise catch handlers.
acceptance_criteria: DOStateError extends Schema.TaggedError with operation (get|set|clear) and message fields
All 3 Effect.tryPromise catch handlers use DOStateError instead of new Error(...)
catchAll handlers remain (graceful degradation is intentional) but now catch DOStateError

stories.title: Update piece routes to use catchTag
stories.description: Replace blanket catchAll with specific catchTag handlers in routes/piece.ts for proper HTTP status codes per error type.
acceptance_criteria: importPiece route uses catchTag for ParseError (400), SqlError (500)
listPieces route uses catchTag for SqlError (500)
No blanket catchAll converting all errors to 400
Response bodies include error field with meaningful message

stories.title: Update session routes to use catchTag
stories.description: Replace blanket catchAll with specific catchTag handlers in routes/session.ts. 5 endpoints need updating.
acceptance_criteria: All 5 session routes use catchTag instead of catchAll
No blanket catchAll converting all errors to 400

stories.title: Fix catchAll in piece RPC handler
stories.description: Replace catchAll with catchTag in rpc/piece.ts:49 to only catch expected SqlError, not swallow all errors.
acceptance_criteria: pieceRepo.getNotes uses Effect.catchTag('SqlError', ...) instead of catchAll
Unexpected errors propagate correctly (not silently swallowed)
